POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.purpose: Resolve an authenticated, signed and compatible package dependency closure for a module without installing it, subtract already-cached public immutable artifacts, and return a canonical lock digest for install-time concurrency checking.
POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.authentication: Required GreenField bearer access session; the authenticated account is resolved server-side.
POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.authorization: The requested module must be catalogue-installable for the authenticated account. Every paid package in the resolved closure requires that account to hold a current TRIAL, ACTIVE or GRACE entitlement. Client-supplied account or ownership fields are rejected.

path.moduleId: Required canonical module or package identifier; aliases are normalized by the server. It never selects a storage path.

body.version: Optional exact semantic version; null or omission selects the highest compatible signed release.
body.platform: Required: ios, android, web, desktop or server.
body.moduleSdkVersion: Optional semantic SDK version reported by the host.
body.productUiContractVersion: Optional semantic product UI contract version reported by the host.
body.hostCapabilities: Optional array of at most 256 validated host capability descriptors: id, version, status, provenance and optional renderer/provider/fallback/constraints.
body.cachedPublicDigests: Optional array of at most 4096 lowercase SHA-256 digests for public immutable artifacts already verified by PackageManager.

request.validation: A JSON object is required. Unknown fields, malformed semantic versions, unsupported platforms, invalid capability descriptors, uppercase/non-SHA digests and limit violations are rejected. Package metadata and dependency graphs are validated server-side; clients cannot supply releases, signatures, storage paths, publisher trust or entitlement facts.

lock.packages: Topologically valid exact releases. Each entry contains schemaVersion, packageId, publisherId, category, version, releaseId, SHA-256 artifact metadata and bounded sizes, server-selected download reference and authorization mode, Ed25519 signature evidence, verified/revoked trust state, host/platform/capability requirements, dependency ranges, cache policy, sharing class and optional execution provider.
lock.aggregateCompressedBytes: Total compressed bytes in the closure.
lock.reusedArtifactDigests: Verified public immutable digests reused from the client cache.

success.lockSha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the complete lock; the install request must return this digest when an optional package closure exists.

400: VALIDATION_FAILED for malformed or unknown request fields, invalid versions/capabilities/digests, invalid dependency constraints or graph-bound violations.
401: UNAUTHENTICATED for a missing, invalid or expired bearer session.
403: FORBIDDEN when the account lacks catalogue access or an active entitlement for any paid closure member.
UNTRUSTED_RELEASE, RELEASE_REVOKED or SIGNER_REVOKED when declared package bytes cannot satisfy the signed trust chain.
404: NOT_FOUND when the module has no declared optional modula.package.1 distribution release. This permits the separate historical standard-install path; it does not advertise an installable package closure.
409: CONFLICT for dependency cycles, missing dependencies, incompatible constraints, unsupported capabilities/platforms or unavailable execution providers.
ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH if retained artifact bytes fail read-time integrity verification.
500: SERVER_ERROR for an unclassified internal failure; secrets and private account facts are not returned.

POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.pagination: Not paginated. Resolution is bounded to 128 selected packages, 16,384 resolver visits, 256 supplied capabilities and 4,096 cached digests.
POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.idempotencyConcurrency: Read-only and deterministic for the same registry, entitlement and request snapshot. No Idempotency-Key is used. lockSha256 is the optimistic concurrency token: install rejects a changed closure instead of silently installing different bytes. Duplicate cached digests do not alter ownership or registry state.
POST /v1/modules/:moduleId/package-insta.versioningCompatibility: HTTP v1. Lock schema is modula.package-lock.1 and package schema is modula.package.1. Only Ed25519-signed releases compatible with the supplied host version, platform, Module SDK, Product UI contract and available capabilities are selected. Unknown/revoked signers and unsupported package metadata fail closed.
